messages:
marcus: Noticed multiple recent support threads where customers were unclear whether to trim context or retry on 429s/timeouts. Suggest a short migration note that consolidates behavior and shows small SDK helpers.
jana: Good idea. Can we include an explicit mapping from product signals -> doc action? e.g., header-based backoff (Retry-After) -> retry_with_backoff; quota-window signals -> switch_model_variant; context-exceeded -> trim_context or summarize_history.
linh: I'll draft the migration note. Plan: 1) quick decision table, 2) two compact SDK snippets (py/js) for header parsing + backoff, 3) a tiny example of trimming vs summarizing with token counts.
marcus: Also add a short section on "when not to trim" (financial tx, legal disclaimers). People trim by default and we need to warn.
jana: Can we add a machine-readable fallback name list for lints and internal automation? Keeps naming consistent across docs and code. Proposed names: trim_context, retry_with_backoff, switch_model_variant, route_to_cache.
linh: Added that to the draft and put a comment for docs-linter team to enforce. Also linked to an internal playground repo for full patterns: github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/fallback-patterns.
marcus: Snippet idea for python parse: ```python
# small Retry-After parse
rt = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
delay = int(rt) if rt and rt.isdigit() else base_backoff
await sleep(delay + random.random())
```
jana: Node snippet for jittered backoff: ```js
const ra = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '0', 10);
const base = Math.max(1, ra || baseBackoff);
await sleep(base + Math.random() * base);
```
linh: For trimming example, I added a pseudo-call: `trim_history(history, max_tokens=1024)` and a before/after token count comment so readers can see impact.
ops-bot: PR opened #3742 by linh 1: "error-ref migration + tiny sdk helpers" (labels: docs, migration)
marcus: Quick UX nit: put the decision table at the top so support can link customers right away. Add a short FAQ entry for "How do I know if I should retry or trim?".
jana: Will add FAQ and a short checklist for support to probe (are you seeing Retry-After? persistent rate? lost context?).
linh: Scheduling a review tomorrow 8:30am PT. If green, I'll merge and ping #support and #eng-runtime with the single canonical link.
marcus: Thanks. Please also add a small changelog line and mark this as part of the "error-ref consolidation" workstream.
